rounds.text: Graviss Hospitality Ltd presents a concerning trend of deteriorating profitability, evidenced by a sharp deceleration in compounded profit growth from 18% over the long term [E18, E19] to a contraction of 22% over the last three years [E20] and a staggering 71% decline over the trailing twelve months [E21]. This fundamental weakness is underscored by a negative return on assets of -0.3%, which significantly underperforms the sector benchmark of 2.12% [E8]. Investors are currently paying a premium for this poor performance, as the stock trades at a P/E ratio of 61x [E1], while the market’s expectations appear detached from reality given that price growth has outpaced profit growth by 39% [E55]. The stock’s momentum is also weak, currently sitting at only 17% of its 52-week range [E5], and the lack of any dividend yield provides no income cushion for shareholders [E4]. Conceded: the company has maintained a 10-year compounded profit growth of 18% [E18], and sales have shown recent growth [E62, E65]. However, the current earnings trajectory is clearly decelerating [E66], casting doubt on the sustainability of the valuation [E6].
